column1: THE ITEM: An intimate wheel-throwing ceramics studio in Chacarita (6 wheels, 1 potter) offering monthly 4-week courses and Saturday taster workshops, anchored by handmade stoneware mugs.

THE SALE: A paid booking for the monthly wheel-throwing course (ARS 120,000/mo) or a taster class (ARS 40,000) that converts to monthly; secondary conversion is student retention past month 2 to fill both Saturday (10:00–13:00) and Wednesday evening (19:00–22:00) cohorts.

1 · TARGET MARKET

Primary: Women 28–45 in Chacarita, Colegiales, Villa Crespo & Palermo in screen-heavy office/tech/design jobs seeking tactile, meditative, offline creative time.

Secondary: English-speaking expats & digital nomads in BA wanting authentic small-group creative classes taught in English.

Tertiary (top-of-funnel): Palermo design fair visitors seeking handmade local gifts.
column2:
2 · MESSAGE

Core Hook: "Tres horas sin pantallas. Barro en las manos, calma en la cabeza." (Three hours offline. Clay in your hands, calm in your head.)

The Differentiator: Not an anonymous, crowded ceramics factory. An intimate 6-wheel garage sanctuary in Chacarita with individual guidance from Lucía, your own wheel every minute, and stoneware you'll actually use at home. English-friendly.
column3:
3 · MEDIA

Palermo Sunday Design Fair: Physical booth as primary local & tourist lead discovery engine (mugs draw eyes, conversation sells classes).

Instagram Reels (@taller.lento): Wheel-throwing process & ASMR videos (centering, trimming, glazing) reaching 5–10x typical audience; bilingual captions.

Google Business Profile / Maps: Free listing for "Taller Lento — Clases de Cerámica y Torno en Chacarita" to capture high-intent local searches.

Targeted Meta Ads ($40/mo): Boost top Reels within 3 km of Chacarita/Palermo.

column1:
4 · CAPTURE LEADS

Fair QR Stand: Tabletop acrylic sign beside mugs: "Probá el torno — Escaneá para info de clases y lista prioritaria", linking straight to WhatsApp with pre-filled message ("Hola Lucía, vi tus tazas en la feria y quiero info de clases").

Instagram Bio: wa.me link directly to WhatsApp chat; remove friction of Linktree/PDF.

WhatsApp Business: Save every inquiry under tags [Interés Sábado], [Interés Miércoles], [Feria], [Taster] — no more lost contacts.
column2:
5 · NURTURE LEADS

48-Hour WhatsApp Follow-up: Send inquiring leads a warm 15-sec video of current students at work + upcoming dates ("Quedan 2 tornos para este mes").

Instagram Stories (3x/week): Behind-the-scenes kiln openings, wheel ASMR, student progress stories, and weekly seat availability count.

Monthly WhatsApp Status / Broadcast: Announce the next month's open cohort seats 10 days before month-end to warm leads and taster alumni.
column3:
6 · SALES CONVERSION

The Two-Step Ladder:
1. Low-risk entry: Saturday Taster ("Probá el torno", ARS 40,000 for 2.5 hrs).
2. The Roll-Over Bridge: Apply 50% of taster fee (ARS 20,000) toward the first monthly course if booked within 48 hours of completing the taster.

Direct Monthly Booking: Clear WhatsApp confirmation with date, Chacarita studio map, and immediate Mercado Pago / Transfer link (ARS 120,000).

column1:
7 · WORLD-CLASS EXPERIENCE

Welcome Ritual: Dedicated wheel prepped with their name, warm herbal tea in a signature yerba-green mug, and guaranteed first thrown piece in lesson 1.

The Keepsake Moment: Lucía snaps 2 candid high-res photos/short clip of each student working clay and sends it via WhatsApp that evening (primed for IG sharing).

Unboxing Graduation: Month-end fired pieces wrapped in kraft paper with twine and a personalized handwritten note from Lucía.
column2:
8 · LIFETIME VALUE

3-Month Skill Horizon: Structure classes so students don't feel "done" in 1 month — Month 1 (Centering & cylinders), Month 2 (Mug handles, bowls, glazing), Month 3+ (Teapots, advanced forms, studio project).

Launch Wednesday Group (19:00–22:00): Catches students who drop Saturday due to weekend travel; adds 4–6 seats ($480k–$720k ARS/mo).

Priority Re-enrollment: Existing students get wheel reservation priority for the following month during week 3 before seats open to the waitlist.
column3:
9 · REFERRALS

"Vení con un Amigx": Both get 10% off when re-enrolling together, or a complimentary handmade mug from the studio collection.

Organic Social Sharing: When sending students their wheel photos/clips: "Si lo compartís en stories, etiquetanos @taller.lento!"

Fair Experience Vouchers: "Regalá una clase de torno" gift cards displayed at the Palermo fair stall — turns tourist/gift buyers into high-value class referrals.

column1: A living document — revisit quarterly; change one square at a time rather than rewriting the plan.
